nom: FARMACY Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin say a little goes a long way and it can feel too rich for daytime or AM use, but most report it still works well without breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or winter-parched skin consistently report significant relief, plumping, and disappearance of dry patches, describing it as rich but not greasy.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balanced, hydrating without oiliness, and suitable for both AM and PM use, though one prefers to skip it in the morning.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report calming, non-irritating effects and no breakouts, but a minority describe reactions ranging from rashes to acne, especially with PCOS or when combined with actives like tretinoin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s report plumping, smoother texture, and reduced fine lines, though one 64-year-old felt a grainy after-feel and another wished it were more moisturizing.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically describe normal, unproblematic skin as a baseline; most reviewers frame their experience around dryness, sensitivity, or acne-proneness.

concerns.aging: Multiple mature reviewers report plumper, smoother, more even-toned skin and reduced fine lines; one 64-year-old reports a grainy after-feel and another says it isn't potent enough for her aging skin's moisture needs.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, especially those with dry or winter-affected skin, report strong, lasting hydration and disappearance of flakiness and tightness.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers explicitly report reduced redness and calmer skin, including one who compares it favorably to Tatcha for this effect.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the ceramides with repairing a compromised barrier, reducing burning from retinol or benzoyl peroxide, and calming eczema or perioral dermatitis; one reviewer's barrier symptoms worsened into a rash and acne.
concerns.spots: Only a couple of reviewers mention dark spots or dark circles, reporting visible brightening and reduction with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even improvement in existing acne; however, two reviewers report clogged pores and pimples and one reports a reaction that progressed to acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the product is not greasy and absorbs well, though a few note it can feel heavy or too rich if used generously, especially in the morning.

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product but my skin unfortuantely had a reaction. The first week it was great! Super mousturizing and didn't make me look greasy at all. But unfortuantely my skin type didn't react well over time. I have extremely sensitive skin and I also have PCOS so when I went through the first week I started getting a rash just along my smile lines to my nose. I thought maybe it'd clear up the more I got used to it but it got worse. It eventually turned into acne and super dry and patchy where it reacted. Once I stopped using it and went back to my old mousturizer it cleared up. I know it works for a lot of people but for those that might have super sensitive skin or PCOS, keep in mind it might create a reaction. Otherwise in the areas that didn't get affected it is super moistizing and smells great. I wish my skin type didn't react so badly, otherwise I'd say it's a great product.

extraits.titre: At 41 yrs old I finally love my skin
extraits.texte: After I turned 40 the line I have been using for 10 yrs stopped working. I developed dry welts on the apple of my cheeks, with my entire face burning & itching. After trying a homemade honey mask my skin slightly improved, so I started researching & that's how I found Farmacy. Within maybe 2 weeks my dry spots were gone & I had them for 3 months! I bought the trial sizes of the entire line & I think I found my product soulmate. My wrinkles are reduced & my skin is glowing. My skin is almost flawless. As somebody who suffered with acne since 3rd grade I have always had a reason to hate looking in the mirror but this is the 1st time in my life I can look & not hate myself. I'm sure it sounds dumb but I cried out of happiness tonight & order bigger sizes of the line. The fact that they even sell trial sizes makes me feel as though this is 1 of the few companies that respect their clients wallets & know they developed amazing product. Thank you guys, you all have developed miracles in all your bottles

I have sensitive, easily congested skin and have not had luck with heavier moisturizers. I have tried plenty of creams, and have gotten pretty good at predicting whether or not a product will break me out on first contact. I kept hearing about this Honey Halo moisturizer and didn't want to commit to the full size until I felt the product and observed my skin's reaction to it. Something told me trying the mini size of this relatively pricey moisturizer would be a mistake, because I might end up falling in love and be forced to buy the larger size forever. I was right. I ended up getting the 1.7 oz jar less than 24 hrs after getting the 0.5 oz mini. This moisturizer glides on much easier than expected. It feels creamy, not greasy, and a little goes a long way. Some thicker creams leave me feeling gross and in need of another wash, but this one sinks in and softens without stickiness. I haven't experienced any of the itching or clogged pores that other rich moisturizers have caused. I don't really like the smell, but it's pretty mild. I plan to use this at night mostly, but it's suitable for daytime use as well.

This is the BEST thing to ever happen to my skin! I was struggling with eczema, dryness, sensitivity and acne. Every moisturizer I tried broke me out worse, or burned after applying. I recieved a free sample of this moisturizer and after trying it twice, I immediately purchased the full size! My skin is smooth and my acne is actually starting to clear up?! I can't believe it. This one is worth the price!

Absolutely luxurious makes my skin feel amazing! I have VERY sensitive skin and am acne prone and this moisturizer is SO non irritating, smells wonderful and is healing my barrier. The only con is the expense of it but a little goes a long way!

I will be absolutely devastated if they ever stop making this or change the formula. My FAVORITE facial lotion ever. Literally transformed my skin in just a couple days of use. I have oily skin so a little goes a long way with this. It's 100% worth the price, and I cannot recommend it enough. My only gripe is the packaging - it's thick and heavy, which seems unnecessary.

I really wanted to love this moisturizer. It smells great and has a lovely texture, and I'm a sucker for anything with honey in it. But every time I use it, I get pimples and visibly clogged pores the next day. I'll use it once, stop for a few weeks, then try again, and the same thing happens every time. I can't figure out what ingredient(s) is causing the problem, as none of them stand out as typical pore-cloggers. So disappointed. Beware if you are at all acne-prone.
